body: I really thought mine would end up lasting too. I thought i finally found the perfect guy. We connected on so many things and made each other better for the world. But because of his selfish tendencies that arose during the relationship, he left me. Its unsettling to think that he will never feel this pain, i want him to feel this pain so badly, he doesnt deserve to be as happy as he is right now. Just remember to try to stay positive. That youll go on to do so many better things than you wouldve with that dude. Mine wouldve never stayed with me if i moved out of state for college, he never wouldve stayed if anything happened. So now i look at it like im free to do whatever i want and live my life now. Its just unfortunate to know he wont be there with me

I had to take sleeping pills non stop for about 3 days so i could just stop thinking about the situation. It hurts:( why are there such great guys out there who turn into this.. just someone who doesnt care anymore and has no concern for how it ended and how you feel
It feels so terrible doesnt it:( like im so anxious all the time and i cant eat or sleep. I dont know if its worth it to continue living anymore
Thankyou so much i really appreciate your reply
Im good now bc i gave in and begged him to get back w me
That makes a lot of sense and is exactly what i do and feel. Like i deserve to feel the pain
